audit.why: Pantheon bullies levels 1-5 and even the 6 window; Ekko takes over at first item and out-scales at two. Content layer and packet chart agree (Pantheon x5, Ekko x2); 54.34% WR fits an early-favoured lane.
All 4 spikes present and grounded: 3-5 kill window, 6 still Pantheon if he bursts through/baits Chronobreak, Ekko 1st-item flip, Ekko 2-item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart carried blanket Skill while content/packet agree; breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were verbatim trade lines; two missing interactions absent (Phase Dive auto-reset as the burst tell, Chronobreak heal wanting anti-heal).
audit.why: Ekko R is 110/80/50 and heals a percentage of recent damage — Grievous Wounds timing matters; W Parallel Convergence 22s, E Phase Dive 9s with an auto-reset wind-up that telegraphs his combo.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned with grounded whys; cooldowns rewritten with 110s/22s/9s; auto-reset tell folded into dosFull[1].d and anti-heal into dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: First item Ekko flips it: W stun, E dash and Chronobreak let him trade and reset on his own terms.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two-plus items he one-shots off a W stun and rewinds his mistakes — group and let CC pin him before you commit your combo.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. It governs your forward steps. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1; it erases your kill and bursts back, so track the hologram and save final damage for after it. - His W stun is 22s and the E hop 9s — both down is your window. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: His combo opens with the Phase Dive auto-reset — the wind-up is your cue to W-stun him before it lands.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-item his rewind heals what you dealt — buy Executioner's before long trades or Chronobreak erases them.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Committing the all-in while Phase Dive or Chronobreak is banked at even HP — a failed Pantheon dive hands Ekko the lane.
